links.outcome: Readability grade level of AI-simplified surgical consent forms versus originals (English)
links.effect: Custom GPT reduced median Fry from 12.0 to 7.0, SMOG 12.3 to 9.3, Flesch-Kincaid 9.6 to 5.9 (all p < 0.001); ChatGPT-4.0 gains were modest (Fry 12.0 to 10.0).
links.quote: Our custom GPT improved English readability, reducing median Fry from 12.0 to 7.0, SMOG 12.3 to 9.3, and Flesch-Kincaid 9.6 to 5.9 (all p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-simplified consent forms in English and Spanish
links.effect: English improved modestly with ChatGPT-4.0 and more with custom GPT; Spanish direct simplification did not significantly improve (GPM 9.5 to 10.0; SOL 9.6 to 9.1; both p > 0.05).
links.quote: Spanish readability did not significantly improve (median GPM 9.5 to 10.0; SOL 9.6 to 9.1; both p > 0.05).
